question: What was the theme of Independence Day in India in the year 2015?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Towards True Freedom**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Towards True Freedom **was the theme of Independence Day in India in the year **2015**.
 
• The theme **"Towards True Freedom"** for Independence Day in India in 2015 likely aimed to reflect on the progress made since India's independence in 1947 and to emphasize the ongoing journey towards achieving true freedom and prosperity for all citizens.
 
• It might have focused on various aspects such as socio-economic development, political empowerment, cultural diversity, and individual liberties.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Independence Day** is celebrated annually on August 15th in India as a public holiday, commemorating the nation's freedom from British rule on August 15, 1947.
 
• This marks the enactment of the Indian Independence Act, transferring legislative sovereignty to the Indian Constituent Assembly.
 
• Although King George VI remained the head of state until the transition to a republic, India formally adopted the Constitution on January 26, 1950, becoming the Republic of India and replacing the prefix "Dominion of India."
 
• India's path to independence was characterized by a notable independence movement, known for its largely non-violent resistance and civil disobedience, led by the Indian National Congress under the guidance of Mahatma Gandhi.
 
• Gandhi drew inspiration from earlier Indian movements, including one led by Ram Singh Kuka, advocating for principles such as non-violence, self-reliance, and civil disobedience throughout the struggle for independence.
